parameters.query:
select a.cdbASAPATH,
d.cdbDescripcion, d.cdbFechaCreacion, a.cdbASACODIGO, a.cdbASATIPO, d.cdbPersona,
td.cdbAuditar, dd.cdbFactLiq,dd.cdbNumero
from [V_DIANIA].[dbo].tdbASAS as a (nolock)
left join [V_DIANIA].[dbo].tdbT2Documentos d (nolock) on d.cdbAsa=a.cdbASACODIGO
left join [V_DIANIA].[dbo].[tdbTIPOSDOC] td (nolock) on td.cdbTIPCODIGO=a.cdbASATIPO
left join [V_DIANIA].[dbo].tdbR2DocCarteraD dd (nolock) on dd.cdbIdDocT2=d.cdbId
left join T_DIANIA.dbo.tdbCarteraCP cpd (nolock) on cpd.cdbFactLiq=dd.cdbFactLiq and cpd.cdbNumero=dd.cdbNumero
where /*d.cdbFechaCreacion between '2026-01-01' and '2026-06-02'
  and*/ upper(right(a.cdbASAPATH,3)) = 'PDF'
and  a.cdbASATIPO = 'PA_CO'
  and dd.cdbNumero is not null
and cpd.cdbNumero is null
order by d.cdbFechaCreacion
